name: markdown-kv
description: A TypeScript library for working with markdown key-value pairs

scripts.release:patch: npm run version:patch && npm run build && git add . && git commit -m "chore: bump version" && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
scripts.release:minor: npm run version:minor && npm run build && git add . && git commit -m "chore: bump version" && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
scripts.release:major: npm run version:major && npm run build && git add . && git commit -m "chore: bump version" && git tag -a v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") -m "Release v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
